thread:
sara: Quick sync 3: NovaHealth POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Need to lock success criteria, tech config, pricing runway, and security gaps before the meeting. @darren @priya @maria can you confirm what you'll bring?

darren: I can bring infra recs. Ask: expected concurrency & token sizes? That drives hosted vs dedicated.

sara: They said primary is clinician-facing triage chat (latency critical) + nightly batch note summaries. Ballpark: 30k chats/mo, peak ~20rps, median prompt ~120 tokens, response ~160 tokens.

priya: Sounds like mixed workload. I'll prepare two proposals: 1) hosted pinned model (fast-hosted) with caching and KV reuse, 2) 3-month reserved dedicated baseline. Each with p50/p95 latency estimates and cost buckets.

maria: Security flags: SSO (SAML), KMS for keys, data residency, and need to know whether they'll supply PHI-masked samples. Also, legal will want an NDA addendum for real PHI examples.

sara: They prefer client-side PHI redaction but want optional server scrubber. Can we demo a server-side PII scrub during POC?

darren: Yes. I'll include a short preprocessor demo snippet and a plan to toggle it on/off.

priya: For evals propose three sets: safety/hallucinations (10 prompts), clinical accuracy (20 cases), UX sessions (10 human-rated). Metrics: factuality, clinical F1, median latency, and user satisfaction. Who owns prompt set? @sara

sara: I'll coordinate with Nova's SME and deliver a first draft of prompts and ground truth by Mon EOD.

darren: Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-fallback to smaller variant if errors >1% or latency spikes >20%. I'll also bring a simple load script to validate 20rps.

maria: I'll send the questionnaire link and three pre-kickoff asks: SSO authority, retention TTL, and whether logs can contain only redacted IDs.

priya: Pricing note: propose 2-week hosted trial with token caps, plus optional 3-month reserved pilot with capped monthly spend. I'll bring unit economics per 1M tokens and sample bill.

sara: Proposed success criteria (we can adjust): 1) >=85% clinical accuracy on test set, 2) p95 latency <=300ms at 20rps (or <=450ms on hosted fallback), 3) cost per chat <=$0.012, 4) SSO + documented KMS/data flow. If met, recommend Dedicated within 30 days.

darren: Agree. I'll note caching/quantization assumptions for the latency numbers in my slides.

maria: Legal and security will need the NDA addendum signed before we accept real PHI. I'll flag them now.

priya: Kickoff agenda I'll share in thread: intros, use-case & data types, tech plan + models, security checklist, success criteria & timeline, actions. I'll drop a 1-pg summary before the meeting.

sara: Action items: Sara = prompts/evals by Mon EOD; Darren = infra config + scrubber demo + load script; Priya = pricing slides + rollout; Maria = questionnaire + access checklist + legal flag.

calendar-bot: Event created: "NovaHealth POC: Day 0" tomorrow 10:00am PT 3 attendees: @sara @darren @priya @maria.

sara: If Nova can share 50 anonymized transcripts beforehand we can pre-run some evals. I'll ask them now.

darren: I'll prep a short perf test to run during the pilot window.

maria: Noted. I'll also confirm required attestations from their InfoSec contact.

sara: Thanks team 3 see you tomorrow.
